lead: eight licensed Kevin MacLeod expedition songs via PLANET_MUSIC.json
weapon_voices: removed from combat, shop preview and codex; legacy sources archived only
chart: beat-matched three-key taps and holds; chords following sector one and cross-lane rolls following sector two; base lookahead 2.9 s divided by the live song rate
song_rate: 1.00 plus 0.045 per finished objective, up to 1.18; OGG playback and score mapping advance together
ammo: square(sum(all3keys earned)/sum(all3keys possible)) sets next6second base ammo; multiply current earnedPerfect bonus,max120percent;opening100percent;zero/recovery and fraction carry retained
mercury_volley: the first playable musical completion at or after charge; taps and chords use the landing, holds and ordered rolls use the tail; existing on-screen gestures keep their shape through rate changes
feedback: independent kill, pickup, shield, impact, UI, alert and rhythm buses; short synthesized rhythm cues follow judged notes, accepted hold heads and earned milestones

rhythm_feedback.early_contact: immediate strike, followed by deferred judgement with no second ordinary strike

perfect_rewards.scope: immediate multiplier on accuracy-squared ammo, not points or damage; count caps remain

damage_growth: Central bounded attribute/level/modifier growth and full-count density sharing before score scaling. Accuracy itself only scales count. Utility dash missiles follow count ratio.
